evidence.reason: The fixture sets only user.email/user.name before committing at line 94 and never disables inherited commit.gpgSign. With global commit.gpgSign=true and no usable signing key for the fixture identity, `git commit` fails and setUp errors for all DeployTests cases. Adding repo-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first fixture commit is a routine hermeticity fix, not a behavior change requiring owner approval.
